#!/bin/zsh
# Acceptance for a caliper build: CLI rows, Storybook Controls rows, oracle headline.
#   accept.sh <caliper-docgen binary> <packages/storybook dir (built: dist/, ../napi with its .node)> <label>
# Output: accept/out-<label>/ (cli/, sb/, weekly.json, accept-<label>.md). Exit 0 = every check passed.
# Env: SKIP_ORACLE=1 skips the oracle step (its check then fails: do not use for sign-off). WEEKLY overrides scripts/weekly.py.
# Timings come from a shared machine: not official. Playwright is the npm package in prefetch/drv (MCP tools cannot run
# from a script). Build the addon dir: git archive <sha> packages/storybook packages/napi, tsc in packages/storybook, and
# copy target/release/libcaliper_docgen_napi.dylib to packages/napi/caliper_docgen_napi.darwin-arm64.node
# (see build-d884334e/ for the layout).
set -u
HERE=${0:A:h}
BIN=${1:?binary}; ADDON=${2:?storybook dir}; LABEL=${3:?label}
FX=/Users/gabe/Projects/caliper-fixtures
WEEKLY=${WEEKLY:-/Users/gabe/Projects/caliper/.claude/worktrees/agent-a5fd7afe2ce9a583f/scripts/weekly.py}   # a worktree with node_modules (rdt.mjs, oracle need them)
OUT=$HERE/out-$LABEL
[ -x $BIN ] || { echo "no binary $BIN"; exit 2; }
[ -f $ADDON/dist/index.js ] || { echo "addon not built: $ADDON/dist/index.js"; exit 2; }
ls $ADDON/../napi/*.node > /dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "no napi .node next to $ADDON"; exit 2; }
rm -rf $OUT; mkdir -p $OUT/sb
echo "== 1/3 CLI rows"; python3 -I $HERE/cli_rows.py $BIN $OUT
echo "== 2/3 Storybook dev mode"; node $HERE/sb.mjs $OUT $ADDON $OUT/sb/out.json
rm -rf $OUT/sb/node_modules $OUT/sb/src $OUT/sb/.storybook   # the cloned demo
if [ -z "${SKIP_ORACLE:-}" ]; then
  echo "== 3/3 oracle (antd, shadcn)"
  (cd ${WEEKLY:h:h} && python3 $WEEKLY --bin $BIN --oracle --corpus antd --corpus shadcn --corpora $FX/corpora \
     --work $OUT/work --runs 1 --out $OUT/weekly.json > $OUT/weekly.log 2>&1; echo "weekly rc=$?")
fi
python3 -I $HERE/report.py $OUT $LABEL
rc=$?
cp $OUT/accept-$LABEL.md $HERE/accept-$LABEL.md
